rides.title: Social Ride 72 km | Copenhagen | Road | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
Nordic Chase is organizes a 72 km social ride around Copenhagen.

We start from the Go Nordic Cruiseline terminal; same spot the Chase to Oslo kicked off from.

Pace will be around 30 km/h, with a few hill sprints thrown in to keep it spicy.

Fair warning: this isn't a beginners ride. You need to be comfortable riding in a group.

Bring your puncture kit and enough food to keep your energy up. First two punctures are on us; after that, you're getting dropped 😅

We'll finish at Kliché Bicycle Store for coffee and cold beers/sodas.

PS: in case of bad weather, we will cancel this social ride. 

Cheers, hope to see you there!

rides.title: Road Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Long Road Ride — a longer endurance ride, with a high tempo. Depending on numbers of participents we will split up in two groups. Riders will rotate turns at the front throughout the ride. Always download the route to your headunit. Target average speed: 32–34 km/h. Participants should be comfortable riding in a group and familiar with standard hand and verbal signals. We usually finish at the shop for a drink or something to eat. 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!

Start time: 09.30
Distance: 100-120 km +/-
Pace: 32- 34 km/h

rides.title: The Annual Ice-Cream Ride (All-Roads)
rides.description:
It’s time for the annual Ice Cream Ride 🍦where we go for a long haul all-roads adventure just to get treated with delicious Ice Cream from our friends at our favourite dairy Hansen Is. 

It might be hot temps, so we place strategic stops on our way to refuel and stay hydrated throughout the whole day. 

We expect you to be able to keep up with an average of 26-27 kph/avg, run tubeless and in fair shape for a 6+ hour ride - in return you get beautiful views of summer in Denmark and calories for days. 

Sign up and join CCCs annual Ice Cream Ride 

Be welcome

rides.title: Women’s weekly gravel training - ice cream edition ✨
rides.description:

Remember to bring snacks, spare parts and good vibes🫶🏻

*****************************************

Distance: aprox. 60km

See you for a fun training 
// Caroline & Julie

rides.title: Shake-out ride | Day before BERLIN to COPENHAGEN | Nordic Chase 2026 | Gravel
rides.description:
Nordic Chase organizes an ultra-gravel race from Berlin to Copenhagen - 739 km.

This shake-out ride is the final spin before the big push to Copenhagen! It's all about breaking the ice; use these kms to meet the riders you'll be chasing over the next few days. It's also the perfect time for a final equipment test.

We'll be hosting the shake-out ride and the start of the race from the old Standert bike shop location. We'll finish back at the Standert shop at 17:30 for the rider briefing and pasta party.

🛠️ What you need to know
Groups: We'll split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.
Navigation: Please make sure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️
Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures — and your best post-taper vibes.

Still want to join Nordic Chase 2026? Head over and register:
👉 https://nordicchase.com/ber-cph-gravel

We have 29 spots left, out of a maximum of 100 riders.

See you there! ✌️

rides.title: Berlin to Copenhagen - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
The big CHASE to Copenhagen! Part of the Nordic Chase Ultra Cycling Series!

Are you ready to Chase: Berlin → Copenhagen.

For this GRAVEL race we are partnering with Standert as host partner in Berlin.

This gravel route takes riders through Germany and Denmark, covering historic towns, rolling farmland, forests, and scenic gravel paths; finishing in the heart of Copenhagen.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

Registrations are open:
👉 www.nordicchase.com
(limited capacity at 100 riders) - we have currently a few spots left only.

Registration includes:
1. Rider briefing and Pasta Party @Standert Bicycles (store in Berlin)
2. Official Race Manual with the race details
3. Race cap and other goodies
4. Live GPS tracking
5. Finisher Certificate
6. Post-ride ceremony with drinks in Copenhagen
7. Photos taken by our media team
8. Entry to WhatsApp group chat to connect other riders
9.  Bag transfer rom the start to the finish

All info is on www.nordicchase.com

Questions, then email to info@nordicchase.com

Please note: The final route will be provided in the race manual. The current route is a draft and will be verified by the organizer. The manual will be emailed to all registered participants three weeks before the race.

rides.title: Copenhagen to Oslo - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)

Copenhagen → Oslo | Self-Supported Ultra-Distance Race

The Nordic Chase returns in 2026!

This Strava event is for the Gravel Edition, taking riders on a wild and scenic journey from Copenhagen to Oslo, crossing Denmark, Sweden, and Norway through remote gravel paths, dense forests, serene meadows, and untouched Nordic wilderness.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

🌍 Full route details and event schedule will be posted on:
👉 www.nordicchase.com/gravel

For more information, please visit www.nordicchase.com or contact us at info@nordicchase.com
